Material character

07 / FINISHES & FABRICATION

Black steel

Matte black powder coat. Main frame 25×25×1.6 MS SHS; secondary frame 20×20×1.6 MS SHS.

Light-neutral steel

1.5 mm powder-coated steel cabinet doors; flush, handleless. No timber.

Textured plaster

Raw light textured plaster. Swatch is indicative; approve physical finish sample.

Stone-look porcelain

1200×600 mm rectified porcelain, 2 mm grout; option A with 5 mm perimeter movement joints.

Clear glass

12 mm clear toughened glass pivot door. Glazier to confirm fabrication and hardware.

Expanded mesh

Black diamond expanded metal, approximately 20×40 mm. Upper side display infill only.

Palette colours are indicative screen references, not procurement specifications.

DESIGN PRESENTATION · REV A

Finishing the picture

08 / COUNTER, CEILING & LIGHT

M7 — counter front and top

Light neutral panel with a simple light-coloured top.

M9 — ceiling

Smooth gypsum, matte warm off-white. Frame fixings must not load the gypsum ceiling.

L1 — lighting

3000 K concealed LEDs, black track spots and recessed downlights.

Floor setting-out

Option A: 1200 mm across, 2 mm grout, 5 mm perimeter joint; end cuts 1194 / 343 mm.

Excluded from the technical scope: timber, brass, decorative arches, heavy joinery, pendants, decorative ceiling features, plants and loose products. Reference boards inform composition only.
